items.exampleEn: This car is theirs, not ours.
items.exampleZh: 這台車是他們的，不是我們的。

items.exampleEn: Please call us if you need further information.
items.exampleZh: 如果需要更多資訊，請打電話給我們。

items.exampleEn: Are you alright? You look tired.
items.exampleZh: 你還好嗎？你看起來很累。

items.exampleEn: I have been to Tainan twice.
Are you done with your homework?
The bank is next to the post office.
She took a book out of her bag.
items.exampleZh: 她從包包裡拿出一本書。

items.sentenceEn: Can I sit next to you?

items.audioEn: Our house is small, but theirs has a big garden.
items.audioZh: 我們的房子很小，但他們的有一個大花園。

items.sentenceEn: No one is at home right now.
Have you ever been to a night market?

items.stemEn: Please get ____ the car. We're here.

items.passageEn: Last night, I heard a strange noise outside. I looked out of the window, but no one was there. Then I saw a cat next to my neighbors' car. "Is that cat theirs?" I thought. The next morning, I asked them. "Yes, it's ours. Is everything alright?" they asked. I have been their neighbor for five years, and I never knew they had a cat!
items.passageZh: 昨晚我聽到外面有奇怪的聲音。我從窗戶往外看，可是沒有人在那裡。接著我看到一隻貓在鄰居的車子旁邊。我心想：「那隻貓是他們的嗎？」隔天早上我問了他們。他們說：「對，是我們的。一切都還好嗎？」我當他們的鄰居五年了，從來不知道他們有養貓！

items.promptZh: 我功課做完了，可以出去玩嗎？
referenceEn: I'm done with my homework. Can I go out and play?
My homework is done. Can I go out to play?
rubricZh: 「做完」可寫例如 I'm done with、My homework is done、I have finished
「可以⋯嗎」用問句（例如 Can I…?、May I…?）

items.promptZh: 我們明天會進一步討論這個計畫。
referenceEn: We will talk about this plan further tomorrow.
Tomorrow we will discuss this plan further.
rubricZh: 用 further 表示「進一步」（例如 talk about it further、discuss it further 等）
明天的事用表示未來的寫法（例如 will、be going to 等）
tomorrow 放句首或句尾都可以
